title: Tour of Seville with art: history, legends and anecdotes
text: We were there during Holy Week and we had the fortune of discovering the city and some of its most special corners with the help of an excellent guide, Marta, capable of transmitting her passion for the city and its history, and doing so in an enjoyable and fun way. The tour is very varied, alternating history, legend and anecdotes that makes you get to know part of the city from different points of view. A very enriching experience and totally recommended.
author: P2447NDsamuelm

title: Marta os the best tourguide i have ever seen in my entire life.
text: I travel a lot due to my work and i always try to make a tour in order to get to know new facts about the city i’m staying at. Without a doubt, Sevilla with Marta has been the best experience regarding previous tours i’ve done. I will definitely recommend it.
author: paulamendezgonz

title: Quite a discovery!
text: We have been to Seville many times but we had never dared to take a guided tour. We discovered Marta thanks to the recommendation of some friends and we couldn't be more delighted with the tour we took. It was enjoyable, fun and very interesting. He showed us some of the most typical corners of Seville from another point of view totally removed from mass tourism. Definitely worth it.
author: luislgzg

title: Beautiful visit
text: Beautiful visit. Very well documented and enjoyable. A beautiful tour of the city streets with lots of good advice. Thanks to Marta for allowing us to get to know Seville with interesting information. We will return to see another tour.
author: gourmetgarum

title: Visit to Seville
text: A great visit led by an excellent guide. We took a tour with Marta throughout the old area and the Jewish quarter of Seville. In this hour and a half we fell in love with the city. Thank you Martha!!!!
author: R581NGsaram

title: A very pleasant experience
text:
The tourist route is very good and interesting. Marta, our tour guide, made our tour a very interesting adventure, despite going with children, she told things so well that my children never got bored.
Totally recommended!
author: luisagI725MI

title: Great experience!!
text: It is not the first time I have visited Seville, but Marta is certainly an exceptional guide. An excellent professional knowledgeable about the history and culture of Seville and her country. In love with her city, and she also gave us super useful advice. It deserves the highest recommendation. Thank you Marta.
author: K5822XHguillermom
